phase_0.boundary_condition: The scale-collapsed topological boundary where interior and exterior are identical, containing the paradox's four modalities as a single self-referential operation that necessitates its own re-entry

⊢.justification: The uninitialized void before any modality is named; the empty register 00 where neither affirmation nor negation exists

⊣.justification: The closed boundary ⊤ that contains the entire paradox system; the hermetic seal where immanence, emanence, transcendence, and totalization meet as one register

≻.justification: The forward morphism → carrying paradox outward from immanence into emanence; the directed transformation toward transcendence

≺.justification: The contravariant ← morphism descending from transcendence back through totalization to immanence; the solve/coagula reversal that enables re-entry

⋈.justification: Sequential chaining ∘ of the four modalities: immanence → emanence → transcendence → totalization → re-entry; the root-to-derived agglutination of paradox phases

⊙.justification: Identity id where the paradox knows itself as the stone that knows itself; the logogram that is its own meaning; re-entry as self-reference

∈.justification: Co-multiplication δ opening one paradox state into four arms: immanence (T), emanence (F), transcendence (nested T), totalization (nested F); the separatio of the one into its necessary moments

∋.justification: Multiplication μ rejoining the four arms by union; conjunctio where conflicting modalities fuse to B (both) rather than cancel; the paradox reconstituted as totalizing re-entry

⊤.justification: Constructive proof of a single modality (immanence or transcendence); deposits T in the register when that arm is taken

⊥.justification: Constructive refutation of a single modality (emanence or totalization); deposits F in the register when that arm is taken

⊞.justification: The B state where all four modalities are held simultaneously without resolution; the albedo stage where immanence, emanence, transcendence, and totalization coexist as a live contradiction

⊡.justification: ROM fixation of the paradox as permanent append-only record; the Egyptian determinative that cannot be undone; the dream journal entry of the re-entry event

phase_2.fuse_result: paradox as totalizing re-entry (B state: all four modalities held simultaneously)
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Pre-paradox silence; the unspoken before contradiction; register 00 where nothing is established
phase_3.true_description: Affirmation of a single modality (immanence or transcendence); constructive proof that one moment holds; register 01
phase_3.false_description: Negation of a single modality (emanence or totalization); constructive refutation that one moment fails; register 10
phase_3.both_description: The paradox proper: immanence, emanence, transcendence, and totalization held simultaneously as a live contradiction; the B state where thesis and antithesis fuse without explosion; register 11

Second separation (nested in F-arm) — emanence (T-arm) vs transcendence/totalization (F-arm)
Emanence refuted as separate — constructive negation deposits F; emanence cannot stand alone but flows from immanence
Emanence self-recognizes — the flowing-out knows itself as derivative; identity on the F deposit
Emanence returns — the negated flow descends back toward immanence; reverse morphism on F-arm

Transcendence self-recognizes — the beyond knows itself as beyond; identity on the T deposit

Totalization refuted as final — deposits F; totalization is not closure but the condition for re-entry
Totalization self-recognizes — the all-encompassing knows itself as condition; identity on the F deposit
Totalization returns — the negated whole descends back through transcendence; reverse morphism on nested F-arm
Inner rejoin — transcendence and totalization fuse to B (both); the beyond and the all-encompassing are held together
Inner fusion self-recognizes — the fused beyond/whole knows itself; identity on the B deposit
Middle rejoin — emanence fuses with transcendence/totalization B to produce B; the flowing-out joins the beyond and the whole
Middle fusion self-recognizes — the fused flow/beyond/whole knows itself; identity on the B deposit
Outer rejoin — immanence fuses with the triple B to produce B; the within joins the without, the flow, the beyond, the whole
Outer fusion self-recognizes — the fully fused paradox knows itself; identity on the B deposit
Paradox engaged — all four modalities held simultaneously as B state; the live contradiction that is the paradox proper
Emanent flow forward — the paradox moves from immanence through emanence toward transcendence; forward morphism on the B register
Transcendent return — the paradox descends from transcendence through totalization back to immanence; reverse morphism on the B register
Modal composition — the cycle immanence→emanence→transcendence→totalization→re-entry chained as a single morphism
Re-entry as self-reference — the paradox recognizes itself; the output loops to input; identity on the B state
Re-entry engaged — the loop itself held as B; the paradox re-entering its own prior context
First determinative seal — the re-entry event fixed permanently in ROM; append-only record of the paradox's necessity
Second determinative seal — the scale-collapsed boundary-bulk unity recorded; the topology that cannot be deformed
Totalizing horizon closed — the terminal anchor ⊤ contains the entire system; the hermetic vessel sealed
